    Left-click / drag
    Select, box-select
    
        
    Right-click
    Move, attack, build, work
    
        
    Double-click
    Select all of that type on screen
    
        
    Z then click
    Attack-move (X stops)
    
        
    .
    Next idle citizen
    
        
    H
    Jump to your Capitol
    
        
    Ctrl/Shift + 1–9
    Make a group; 1–9 recalls
    
        
    WASD, edges
    Move the camera; wheel zooms
    
        
    Middle-drag
    Rotate and tilt the camera
    
        
    M
    Mute or unmute
    
        
    Ctrl + S
    Save the game (Menu loads)
    
      
    
      
    Counters hold in every era: foot soldiers (spears, swords, muskets, rifles) beat riders and tanks; riders and tanks beat archers, crossbows and machine guns; those beat foot soldiers. Siege smashes buildings, and fighters rule the air. Your Capitol and towers shoot back. Everything you have holds its resources while it exists: lose a producer and your newest units that need it lose health. Grow from village to empire by building (K shows the tech tree), and win by conquest.

    Tech tree
    
        
      
    
      
    Each building unlocks the next; nothing is researched. Costs are slots, held while the thing exists, and every unit is also a person. Later eras come as your houses grow: each era's house holds more kinds of goods.
